source.format: sRGB RGBA8 red, green, blue, alpha

boundary.probe: A fresh process renders 15 then a previously unseen 45. For each state the production interactive request is followed by a separate 60 MP canonical settled request and CPU-readable 2400 by 1600 sRGB buffer. Per-request times exclude hashing, later byte archival and previous interactive rendering. Within the process the second state can reuse native source and transmission, but its finished image does not exist at request start. The probe records the application lifetimes as nested white-box stage times; nested durations are not additive.
boundary.wholeProcessPeak: Darwin TASK_VM_INFO ledger_phys_footprint_peak over the complete standalone run including both interactive and settled renders and laboratory output handling. Guide byte accounting and total peak physical footprint are separate.
boundary.directByteScope: Complete final display buffers after native 60 MP processing. This experiment does not export and compare two independent full-resolution 60 MP RGBA files. Export retains the existing implementation.

implementation.productionDefault: Use the resident bounded guide only for the canonical FIT path with a pinned FlashRaw native image, unified Metal memory, a positive worker allowance of at least 512 MiB, longest display edge at most 2400, admitted dimensions, neutral upstream edits or white balance, and a prepared dehaze-only recipe. Otherwise use the existing exact fallback.
inputIdentity: native source key and captured device/inode/size/mtime/ctime
full prepared source binding, upstream fingerprint, RGB airlight and algorithm
positive V2 or signed restore formula
implementation.reuseLifetime: Storage is a shared Metal buffer. The normal bounded native pool charges actual page-aligned bytes before creating it. Its default budget is min(1 GiB,physicalMemory/12) with two entries. Creation also requires 512 MiB of remaining recommended GPU working set after this allocation. Source invalidation, retirement, memory pressure and shutdown release entries after the final active pin.
implementation.transport: The same native GPU scalar graph renders joined 256-row R32F bands. Finite rows are copied into shared memory once. Core Image receives the original 256 by 256 tiled provider sampling and orientation. The old reference wrote one row at a time to a temporary R32F file, synced it and read it for the current request.
implementation.stageChecks: Only an image object checked at the same named native boundary can reuse that check. The restored result of each new strength still completes its own native finite and coverage validation. Export, combined recipes, low-headroom and unsupported devices retain the existing route.

rawmaster.boundary: First production interactive request through full sRGB8 readback, then immediate canonical settled request and full sRGB8 readback. Both full hashes after timing; app gesture debounce excluded.

lightflow.boundary: Changed resident recipe to complete CPU-accessible 2400 × 1600 sRGB RGBA8 display buffer; hash outside timer
lightflow.timing: Sample ms is first changed viewerFrame entry to the final complete CPU-readable RGBA8 buffer, including subsequent scheduling. renderToFirstExactFinalMs ends at the earliest whole-buffer match with that final output. Per-frame ms measures one viewerFrame. actionToPixelsMs includes the initial animation frame. idleConfirmedMs ends at the first following tick with neither draw nor busy. Pixel verification follows all timed work.
